TEMPTATION ||| Lean closer, brushing against his shoulder ||| "What if I told them I trust you?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, pulling my hand away from his ||| "I need space to think, Julian."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze directly, letting my heart show ||| "I feel lost without your guidance right now."  
REVERSAL ||| Grip the Answer tightly, asserting my control ||| "I won't answer until I know the truth."  
SILENCE ||| Stand frozen, breath catching in my throat |||
